The v2 JSON API requires token authentication for access; authentication is not treated as a grant of proprietary rights. No automated provider-data request was sent. The official legacy HTTPS query form requires reCAPTCHA and says users needing more than 100 light curves should contact ASAS-SN. The published V2 client and documentation currently use an unencrypted HTTP API, while the linked HTTPS V2 host and client repository are unavailable. CTAS therefore withholds automatic ingestion until ASAS-SN publishes a current secure, bounded machine-access contract.
